# dsh-bookshelf

A local PDF and EPUB bookshelf for the DeepSeek Harness
Web GUI. It adds a **Bookshelf** entry to th

e left sidebar and a shelf in the main
panel. Library, covers, progress, bookmarks and settings live

under
`$DSH_HOME/bookshelf`, so they survive reloads and restarts.
## Features

- **One Import books menu**: **Import book files…** (picker or drag-and-drop,
copies into the shelf)

and **Link a folder…** (soft links; on Windows a staged
copy when symlink creation is denied). Orig

inals are never deleted.
- **Apple Books import** (macOS): search the local library and link a downl

oaded
EPUB/PDF; EPUB source folders are packed on demand.
- **Shelf**: cover grid, search, sort, ren

ame, delete.
- **PDF.js reader**: fit page/width/custom zoom, single/continuous pages, page
bookmark

s, progress restore.
- **EPUB reader**: paged/scroll, TOC, typography, light/dark themes, automatic

two-page layout, fullscreen, bookmarks, progress restore.
- **Page discussion** (EPUB): capture the

visible page into
`.dsh-bookshelf/<id>.md` in a chosen workspace, open a native conversation with
an

`@file` draft (nothing is sent), and show the page in the static **Books**
sidebar tab.
- English/C

raft (nothing is sent), and show the page in the static **Books**
sidebar tab.
- English/Chinese UI.
## Install

Requires DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`, Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, on macOS or
Windows.

The bundle inserts `ui-bookshelf`; reload the Web page after replacing client
files.
## Usage
Open **Bookshelf** in the sidebar, then **Import books**:

- **Import book files…** — choose one or several EPUB/PDF files, or drop files
on the shelf.
- **Lin

k a folder…** — choose a folder, review its books, and add them as soft
links (or copies on the Wind

ows fallback).
- **Apple Books** (macOS) — search the local library and link a downloaded book.

Progress and bookmarks are stored on the Host. Switching panels preserves the
open book, search/sort

and scroll; a page reload returns to the shelf with
progress intact.
## Platform
| Platform | Shelf + readers | File import | Folder linking | Apple Books |

| macOS | Yes | Yes | Soft links | Yes |
| Windows | Yes | Yes | Soft links with Developer Mode; oth

erwise copy | No |
| Linux | Not declared | — | — | No |

**Windows.** Folder linking needs `SeCreateSymbolicLinkPrivilege`. Without it,
the Host automaticall

y saves a staged copy and labels it **copy**; enable
**Settings → Privacy & security → For developer

s → Developer Mode** (then sign
out/in) or run DSH elevated for true soft links. File import and dra

g-and-drop
need no symlink privilege. Unrelated errors are reported, and failed copies
clean up. Cov
ered by simulated tests on macOS, not real Windows hardware.

**Apple Books.** macOS only; on Windows the button, setting and routes are
unavailable (`501`). If t

he library is unavailable, grant DSH **Full Disk
Access**. Books that are not downloaded show as una

y is unavailable, grant DSH **Full Disk
Access**. Books that are not downloaded show as unavailable.
## Data and privacy
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Deleting an entry removes its shelf file, cover and reading state; it never
follows or deletes a lin

ked source. The plugin has no telemetry and does not
upload books. Page-discussion files stay in the

selected workspace under
`.dsh-bookshelf/` and are not added to a model context until you send a me

ssage
that references them.
## Development
Pure Node tests:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Browser regressions need Chrome and React UMD fixtures. Set
`BOOKSHELF_TEST_FIXTURES` to a directory

containing the React/React DOM UMD
files; set `CHROME_BIN` if Chrome is not at its default macOS pa

th. Run
`node tests/file-import.mjs`, `tests/pagination-geometry.mjs`,
`tests/tab-persistence.mjs`,

`tests/reading-snapshot.mjs`, or
`tests/discussion-handoff.mjs`. They use isolated temporary homes a

nd Chrome
profiles and do not touch a personal library.
## License

MIT — see LICENSE. Bundled PDF.js, fflate, fonts, CMaps and WebAssembly
assets retain their upstream

notices under `assets/licenses`,
`assets/wasm` and `assets/standard_fonts`.

Developed and tested on macOS. Windows folder linking is covered by simulated
failure tests; the rea

l Windows symlink-denial path has not been exercised on
Windows hardware. Shelf rendering is verifie
d in the running Web GUI.
